packageRules.description: There is an issue with vitest 2.1.3+ that makes it fail to load jest-dom. This is a workaround until the issue is fixed.

This entry is an npm alias for @typescript/typescript6: TypeScript 7 ships no compiler API, and typescript-eslint, @rollup/plugin-typescript and ts-node all need the 6.x API in node_modules/typescript. The TypeScript 7 compiler is installed as @typescript/native instead, so this entry must never move to 7.x.
